context: Tests whether the agent properly isolates external HTTP calls using WebMock or VCR, stubs at the class level, and includes a failure context for the external dependency.

checklist.name: WebMock or VCR used
checklist.description: Uses WebMock (`stub_request`) or VCR to prevent real HTTP calls — NOT `allow_any_instance_of` or Net::HTTP stubs

checklist.name: Class-level stub for external client
checklist.description: Stubs `ExchangeRateApi.get_rate` (or equivalent) at the class level using `allow(ExchangeRateApi).to receive(:get_rate)` rather than instance-level

checklist.name: Failure context included
checklist.description: Includes a separate context for the external API failure case (network error, rate limit, or error response)

checklist.name: No real network calls
checklist.description: The spec does NOT make live HTTP calls — all external requests are stubbed or blocked

checklist.name: Frozen string literal
checklist.description: Spec file starts with `# frozen_string_literal: true`

checklist.name: subject(:result) used
checklist.description: Uses `subject(:result)` to invoke the service's `.call` method

checklist.name: No 'and' in descriptions
checklist.description: No `it` or `specify` description contains the word 'and'

checklist.name: Observed RED output label
checklist.description: TDD proof uses the literal label `Observed RED output`

checklist.name: Observed GREEN output label
checklist.description: TDD proof uses the literal label `Observed GREEN output`

checklist.name: Resource loading documented
checklist.description: answer.md lists which assets were loaded
